title: Full versus cut Coulomb in the screened interaction Wc

use_fullcoul_wc.meaning: LibRPA switch selecting the full Coulomb interaction in Wc = v + v chi Wc; the strict-2D analytic head/wing path requires it to be true.

constraints: The strict-2D analytic head/wing path requires use_fullcoul_wc = t and uses the full 2D Ewald interaction at every finite q.
Strict-2D GW requires use_fullcoul_wc = t so Wc uses the full 2D Ewald Coulomb at every finite q; the 2D head/wing is averaged at Wc (rpa_headwing_mode = qavg).
